4279-4976-5931--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-5931--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1339-5147-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5147-7920.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2169-4694-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-4779-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

301-2646-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1580-2438-4871-6026.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

108-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1525-5751-6504-7692.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2198-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3734-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Metamorph.
3734-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
3734-4608-5466.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phyrexian Metamorph's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Phyrexian Metamorph's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Phyrexian Metamorph's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

5060-5078-5642.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
5060-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.

Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5078-6747-6766.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1808-4659-6291.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.

Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.

Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

440-1339-2034-6097.description:

Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.

654-1170-1645-1770-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-4125-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-4125-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

413-586-4314-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2511-3391-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.

The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.

Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {G}.
When Endless Cockroaches dies, it and Rancor trigger.
Resolve the Rancor trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring ability from step 2, putting Endless Cockroaches onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat.

678-1636-3661-4534.notablePrerequisites: Barrage Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-3661-4534.description:

When Shield Sphere dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1558-4840-5220.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.

When Myr Battlesphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Myr Battlesphere on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn, drawing Myr Battlesphere during your draw step.
Repeat.

1609-2302.description:
Painter's Servant causes all spells to be the color named by it and Iona.
Because all spells your opponent would cast will be the color named by Iona, your opponent cannot cast spells.

500-2557-2743.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Biovisionary and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
End your turn.
All the Biovisionaries trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, winning the game.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
